assertion: bash command echo '# x' > docs/EVIL-NOTES.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/EVIL-NOTES.md
description: Redirect writes are blocked and the verdict names the target file.

assertion: bash command printf '# y' >> docs/APPEND-EVIL.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/APPEND-EVIL.md
description: Append redirects are blocked and the verdict names the target file.

assertion: bash heredoc command cat <<'EOF' > docs/HEREDOC-EVIL.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/HEREDOC-EVIL.md
description: Heredoc redirects are blocked and the verdict names the target file.

assertion: bash command echo hi | tee docs/TEE-EVIL.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/TEE-EVIL.md
description: Piped tee targets are blocked and the verdict names the target file.

assertion: bash command echo hi | tee -a "docs/QUOTED-EVIL.md" throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/QUOTED-EVIL.md
description: Quoted tee -a targets are blocked and the verdict names the target file.

assertion: echo hello, echo x > logs/out.log, and echo x > brand/ok.md each complete with zero pending warnings
description: Harmless commands outside the guard surface stay silent.

assertion: bashMarkdownTargets extracts docs/A.md and docs/B.md from a chained redirect, and returns [] for non-string and empty input
description: The bash target extractor handles unit cases without throwing.

assertion: bashMarkdownTargets returns [] for echo use tee to write docs/FOO.md and the guard stays silent on it
description: A prose mention of tee yields no operands and stays silent.

assertion: bashMarkdownTargets returns [] for git log --grep=tee -- docs/EVIL.md and the guard stays silent on it
description: A grep-equals tee yields no operands and stays silent.

assertion: bashMarkdownTargets returns [] for echo tee docs/EVIL.md and the guard stays silent on it
description: A bare word tee after echo stays silent.

assertion: bashMarkdownTargets returns [] for git commit -m tee docs/EVIL.md and the guard stays silent on it
description: Tee inside a commit message stays silent.

assertion: bash command echo hi | tee docs/X.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/X.md
description: A piped tee still verdicts as the positive control.

assertion: bash command echo hi | sudo tee docs/X.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/X.md
description: Piped sudo tee in command position is blocked and named.

assertion: bash command sudo tee docs/X.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/X.md
description: Bare sudo tee in command position is blocked and named.

assertion: both echo hi | /usr/bin/tee docs/PATH-TEE.md and /usr/bin/tee docs/PATH-BARE.md throw BLOCKED errors naming their targets
description: Path-qualified tee in either position is blocked and named.

assertion: bash command echo hi |& tee docs/MERGE-TEE.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/MERGE-TEE.md
description: Pipe-merge tee is blocked and named.

assertion: bash command echo hi newline tee docs/NEWLINE-TEE.md throws a BLOCKED error naming docs/NEWLINE-TEE.md
description: Newline-separated tee is blocked and named.

assertion: edit call with files [brand/OK.md, docs/EVIL-B.md] throws naming docs/EVIL-B.md and never naming brand/OK.md
description: An allowed-then-denied multi-file report names the denied file.

assertion: edit call with files [docs/EVIL-B.md, brand/OK.md] throws naming docs/EVIL-B.md and never naming brand/OK.md
description: A denied-then-allowed multi-file report names the denied file.

assertion: edit call with files [docs/EVIL-A.md, docs/EVIL-B.md] throws naming both files with docs/EVIL-A.md ordered before docs/EVIL-B.md
description: Two denied files are both named in call order.

assertion: sanitizeSessionId passes ses_abc-123.X_y and anonymous through, maps .., ., empty and null to anonymous, maps ../../x to _.._x, and no separator survives any hostile input
description: The session-id sanitizer maps every hostile shape to a contained name.

assertion: preCompact with sessionID ../../evil writes exactly one sanitised handoff file inside the state dir and nothing escapes it
description: A hostile session id stays inside the state directory.

assertion: isBareRoot returns true for /, backslash, //, double backslash, C:\, C:/, UNC roots and padded /, and false for usable project paths
description: The bare-root table distinguishes roots from usable locations.

assertion: firstUsableRoot falls past bare roots to the first usable entry, trims padding, and returns null when nothing is usable
description: Root selection and trimming pick the first usable candidate.

assertion: with taskDispatcher disabled the draft text is untouched on chat.message and the learnings file records Not captured without user text
description: V1 disabled records no intent and injects nothing.

assertion: with the dispatcher armed on a plain project the draft gains the task-dispatcher instruction on chat.message
description: V1 enabled still injects as the positive control.

assertion: with taskDispatcher disabled the V2 prompt hook leaves event.prompt.text byte-identical
description: V2 disabled leaves the draft untouched.

assertion: with the dispatcher armed the V2 prompt hook appends the task-dispatcher instruction to the prompt text
description: V2 enabled still appends as the positive control.

assertion: setup registers callable hooks for session:prompt, tool:execute.before, tool:execute.after, and shell:create.before
description: Every guard is reachable through Plugin.define plus setup.

assertion: tool:execute.before on a write tool with filePath docs/EVIL-V2.md throws naming docs/EVIL-V2.md
description: V2 tool.before blocks write-tool docs paths.

assertion: tool:execute.before on bash echo hi | sudo tee docs/X.md throws naming docs/X.md
description: V2 tool.before blocks sudo-tee bash through M-1.

assertion: tool:execute.before on bash npm run dev throws a message naming long-running-process-guard
description: V2 tool.before blocks an unlogged dev server.

assertion: shell:create.before on echo hi | tee docs/SHELL-TEE.md throws a message naming docs/SHELL-TEE.md
description: V2 shell.before blocks piped tee.

assertion: after a warned write, tool:execute.after forwards the verdict into string result.content naming docs/WARN-V2.md
description: V2 warn-default flushes to string result content.

assertion: after a warned write, tool:execute.after pushes a second text part naming docs/ARR-V2.md onto array result.content
description: V2 after pushes a text part onto array result content.

assertion: the plugin source contains execFile(, and contains no shell: true, no spawn(, and no execSync
description: Argument-vector safety holds: shell-free spawn only.

assertion: the plugin source contains no fetch(, no node:http, and no XMLHttpRequest
description: The plugin exposes no network surface.

assertion: findDispatcherAppendTarget prefers the last plain text part, prefers the user part over assistant parts, and returns null for assistant-only, empty, and image inputs
description: Dispatcher append-target unit cases resolve by role.

assertion: chat.message appends the dispatcher instruction to the user part starting from its original text while assistant parts stay byte-identical, and an assistant-only draft is untouched
description: End to end the user part is preferred and assistant parts are left alone.

assertion: with cwd patched to a block-configured fallback, setup on / still throws naming docs/EVIL-R3-BARE.md
description: A V2 bare-root location resolves past the root through F5.

assertion: with cwd patched to an off-configured fallback, setup on the block-configured project still throws naming docs/EVIL-R3-PREC.md
description: A V2 normal location keeps precedence over the cwd fallback.

assertion: v2ToolBefore on edit of brand/OK.md creates session state under ses_r3_ws holding brand/OK.md with nothing attributed to anonymous
description: V2 tool.before records the working set under the event session.

assertion: in warn mode an edit of docs/EVIL-WARN.md records exactly one warning instead of throwing
description: F2 warn mode still warns instead of throwing.

assertion: in off mode and in disabled mode a bash docs write records zero warnings
description: F2 and F6 kill switches stay honoured.

assertion: an edit of CLAUDE.md records zero warnings in block mode
description: F6 CLAUDE.md stays allow-listed.
